title: Convolutional Neural Networks
blurb: From convolution mechanics through landmark architectures to segmentation, adversarial robustness, and non-image domains.

lecture.summary: Build every CNN primitive from scratch — convolution to ResNet skip connections — developing spatial intuition for how networks learn visual hierarchies on CIFAR-10.
takeaways: Implement convolution, pooling, and receptive fields from scratch.
The architectural arc LeNet → AlexNet → VGG → ResNet, and what skip connections fix.
Transfer learning, batch norm, augmentation, and efficient convolutions for real vision.

snippet.caption: A convolution slides one small kernel over the image.
snippet.code:
# output pixel = elementwise product of a patch and the kernel
out[i, j] = (patch(img, i, j) * kernel).sum()
# learn many kernels, stack layers -> a CNN that sees hierarchy

subLessons.title: Convolutional Neural Networks
subLessons.intro: Vision-shaped networks: slide learnable filters over the image, share weights for translation equivariance, and regularize with augmentation.
